title: Rally engine component diagram
description: The pure game: fixed-step rules, the computer player, and the one-player match the server replays. Only + − × ÷ and √, so every browser and the server compute the same match.

components.name: Rally engine
components.responsibility: The match, with no DOM and no timers.

components.name: Match rules (rules.ts)
components.responsibility: Table, paddles, ball, serve, returns, scoring and win by two; step(state, controls, dt) advances a State and returns events.

components.name: Computer player (ai.ts)
components.responsibility: Cpu: three levels that predict the ball with an error and move at a capped speed.

components.name: One-player match (match.ts)
components.responsibility: Scoring, the Recorder of the player's controls, and replay(seed, level, recording) for the server.

components.name: Seeded generator (rng.ts)
components.responsibility: mulberry32, so a seed replays a match exactly.

relationships.description: Chooses the first server and serve slopes.
Reads the State and returns a Control.
Plays the match in a replay.
Replays against the same Cpu, seeded from the match seed.
